Our Story

Rooted in Heritage,
Styled for New York

Desi Attire NY was born from a simple belief: that South Asian women and men in New York deserve access to truly beautiful traditional attire — without flying abroad or settling for something that doesn't fit.

From our location at 1074b Liberty Ave, Brooklyn/Queens, we serve communities across all of New York with hand-selected pieces direct from South Asia, combined with local tailoring that ensures every garment feels made just for you.

Follow @desiattireny
